trends.whatProductOffers: Pays 100% of the sum assured plus US$650 or HK$/MOP5,000 to the chosen beneficiary on the insured's death, after deducting outstanding policy amounts.
exclusionsOrConditions: Outstanding amounts owed to AIA are deducted before payment.
Cover is pure death benefit; there is no cash value or savings element.
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, the death benefit is 100% of the sum assured plus a small fixed amount, so the cover amount is easy to explain and compare.
verificationPrompts: Agree the sum assured from income replacement and debts
Check that no cash value is expected
sourceEvidence: If the insured ... passes away, we will pay the death benefit to the person whom you select in your policy as beneficiary

Only products then made available for the conversion privilege can be chosen.

trends.whatProductOffers: Guarantees yearly renewal up to the insured's age 85 and states the premium will not be raised because of changes in the insured's health condition, with renewal rates set by attained age.

keyFigures.label: Health-based loading
keyFigures.condition: Premium not raised for health changes

exclusionsOrConditions: Renewal premium is based on the prevailing rates for the insured's age at renewal, so it rises with age.
Premium rates are non-guaranteed and can be revised by the company.
The guarantee is against health-based loading, not against age-based increases.
Cover cannot be renewed beyond age 85.
clientSignalPhrases: worried about losing cover after diagnosis
wants renewal without a health check
negativeSignalPhrases: wants a level premium that never changes
trends.talkingPointTemplate: For {client_detail}, the policy renews every year to 85 and a change in health will not be used to refuse renewal or load the premium — though the rate still rises with age.
verificationPrompts: Explain that renewal rates are age-banded, not level
